g.text: PROTOCOL | Frozen v4 S1 pilot design (prospective; no study results)
3 models (GPT 6.1 Sol, Sonnet 5.5, Gemini 4 Argon) x Arms A/B/C x 2 trajectories = 18 runs (seed 2027 blocks)
Fresh session per step; repo inherited | Robot motifs = role metaphors (same model per run; F_t/P_t external)
318 pilot sessions (133.5 max h); 9 cal. separate
B-A adds post-step budget; B-C shares 15-min ceiling
